bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; eliminating fees for certified birth certificates for newborns; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 144.226, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 144.226, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 9.

Birth records fees waived for newborns.

A parent of the subject of a birth record shall not be charged any of the fees specified in this section for a certified birth record if the subject of the birth record is less than a year old.
